title: SDG4LLM-Bench Submission
description: Schema for official SDG4LLM-Bench leaderboard submissions. The composite unique key is (method_name, teacher_model).

method_name.description: Name of the SDG technique (e.g. 'Evol-Instruct', 'Self-Instruct', 'WRAP'). Part of composite unique key.

teacher_model.description: Model used to generate the synthetic data (e.g. 'gpt-4o', 'meta-llama/Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct'). Required — submissions without this are rejected. Part of composite unique key.

method_description.description: Brief description of the SDG method.

task_results.description: Per-task evaluation results. All four canonical tasks must be present.

num_samples.description: Number of synthetic training samples used. Max 40,000 for primary track, 5,000 for low-resource track.

track.description: Leaderboard track. Submissions with num_samples <= 5000 are eligible for both tracks.

canonical.description: Whether this run used the locked canonical config. Must be true for official leaderboard eligibility.

geo_mean_delta.description: Geometric mean of per-task deltas. Computed automatically; set to null or 0.0 if not qualified.

qualified.description: Whether all four task deltas are strictly positive. Computed automatically.

repo_url.description: Optional URL to the code repository for the SDG method.

paper_url.description: Optional URL to the associated paper.

baseline_score.description: Published seed-only baseline score for this task.

sdg_score.description: Score achieved by the submitter's SDG-trained model.

delta.description: sdg_score - baseline_score. Must be strictly positive for qualification.
